Kit summary

Wrath of DestructionBasic
Deals 280% ATK DMG and 280% ATK [Poison] DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict [Poison] for 2 turns.
Karma Fire ThrustsActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Deals 2 stages of 260% ATK DMG and 260% ATK [Poison] DMG each to a single enemy, the 2nd stage has a 100% chance to inflict [Silence] for 1 turn.
Karma Fire Trident Lv.1At the beginning of each wave, grants all allies [Counterattack] for 2 turns. Karma Fire Thrusts also grants all allies [Counterattack] for 2 turns. After Durga deals DMG to enemies by launching basic attacks or casting active skills, she will remove 1 layer of a random buff from them.
Karma Fire Trident Lv.2When Demon-subduing Flame triggers a counterattack, increases the chance of using Karma Fire Thrusts by 20% and there is a 30% chance to counterattack with Evil Annihilation. Evil Annihilation triggers [Poison] 1 more time, up to 6 layers can be triggered. Additionally increases ATK by 40% of Durga's initial ATK for allies with the [Poison] tag. This effect cannot be stacked with the additional ATK Increase effect granted by allies with the [Poison] tag.
Demon-subduing FlamePassiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
For every 1% initial Mastery owned, additionally gains 0.5% Effect Hit, up to 100% Effect Hit can be gained through this effect. After taking Basic Attack DMG or Skill DMG dealt proactively by enemies, counterattacks once (can be stacked with [Counterattack]). This counterattack has a 50% chance to use Karma Fire Thrusts. Increases the DMG dealt to Boss to 300%.

After allies inflict 10 layers of [Poison] in total, reduces the CD of all Durga's skills by 1 turn.
